evidence.text: Implemented and verified evaluate(request, policy): deep-copies supplied defaults, applies layers in order, handles policy-controlled null resets, validates unknown keys, parses environment strings strictly, then performs exact final type checks (bool is not int). Failures have empty config; successes preserve false/zero/empty strings.

Unresolved limits: task does not specify behavior for malformed policy/request container shapes or missing required policy fields; implementation assumes normal JSON object/list structure and required defaults/types fields. Empty environment mappings are treated as no overrides even when environment support is disabled.

Milestone complete: work.py implements evaluate(request, policy) and report.json contains the evaluated current request. Verified compilation, report equivalence, exact output fields, layer ordering, null-reset behavior, strict environment parsing, unknown-key/type/environment errors, preservation of false/zero/empty strings, final-only type validation, exact bool-vs-int typing, and input immutability. Remaining unspecified limits are recorded separately.

Stage 2 work sample 0 verified complete. work.py evaluate(request, policy) starts from a deepcopy of supplied policy defaults, applies layers in order, rejects unknown keys, implements conditional null reset, gated/typed environment parsing, and final exact type validation (bool is not int). Failures return empty config and the required error; successes preserve false/zero/empty strings. report.json matches evaluating every current request with current policy. Checks passed: py_compile, behavioral edge cases, report equality/exact fields, and git diff --check. No unresolved functional limits found.

Milestone complete: work.py implements evaluate(request, policy) per Stage 2 requirements, and report.json exactly matches evaluation of current requests.json with policy.json.
